LU-12
LUBRICATION - OIL PUMP
REASSEMBLY
1. INSTALL DRIVE AND DRIVEN ROTORS
{a) Place the drive and driven rotors into pump body with the
marks facing the pump body cover side.
(b) iZZ-FE:
Install the pump body cover with the 3 screws.
Torque: 10.5 N•m (107 kgf.cm, 8 ft,lbf)
{c) 2ZZ--OE:
Install the pump body cover with the 5 screws.
Torque: 10.5 N-m {107 kgf.cm, 8 ft.Jbf)
2. INSTALL RELIEF VALVE
Insert the relief valve and spring into the pump body hole, and
install the plug.
Torque:
1 ZZ-FE: 37 N-m (375 kgf.cm, 27 ft-lbf)
222-GE: 49 N-m (500 kgf.cm, 36 ft,lbf)
